background: Lloyds Bank plc is the main ring-fenced bank of Lloyds Banking Group, the UK's largest retail bank, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages, cards, motor finance and to UK companies.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, all three on a stable outlook after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the ratings sit at the bottom of the double-A range. Leverage of 5.1% is in the top quarter, though it has fallen 0.3 points since 30 Jun 2025, and CET1 of 13.6% is just below the peer median. Liquidity is the weak spot, with LCR of 134% and NSFR of 118% both in the bottom quarter of UK majors, though both have been broadly flat. The newest flagged item, on 9 Oct 2026, is an online banking outage, and the larger matter in the period is the fraud claims over the Arena Television loans.
